question: 上海有多少位客户？

expect.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE city = '上海'

notes: 单值答案 9，偶然命中风险较高

question: 列出所有已下架商品的名称和价格

expect.gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE is_active = 0

question: 哪些商品已经没有库存了？给出 SKU 和商品名称

expect.gold_sql: SELECT sku, name FROM products WHERE stock = 0

question: 价格最高的 3 个商品是什么？按价格从高到低列出名称和价格

expect.gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3

question: 每个商品分类下各有多少个在售（上架）商品？

expect.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(p.id) FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id AND p.is_active = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name

question: 哪些客户从来没有下过单？列出客户编号和名称

expect.gold_sql: SELECT customer_no, name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

question: 评分低于 3 分的评价都是针对哪些商品的？列出商品名称和评分

expect.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, r.rating FROM product_reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE r.rating < 3

question: 北京的客户一共下了多少笔订单？

expect.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.city = '北京'

question: 各个订单状态分别有多少笔订单？

gold_sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY order_status
SELECT d.dict_label, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_type = 'order_status' AND d.dict_value = o.order_status GROUP BY d.dict_label

notes: 状态码或字典中文标签均可

question: 每个下单渠道的订单平均应付金额是多少？

gold_sql: SELECT channel, AVG(total_amount) FROM orders GROUP BY channel
SELECT d.dict_label, AVG(o.total_amount) FROM orders o JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_type = 'channel' AND d.dict_value = o.channel GROUP BY d.dict_label

question: 按全部订单明细的购买件数合计，销量最高的 4 个商品是哪些？给出商品名称和件数

expect.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(i.quantity) FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY SUM(i.quantity) DESC LIMIT 4

notes: 第 4、5 名件数不同（40 与 35），前 4 名内部有并列，因此不比较顺序

question: 哪个商品分类的平均评分最高？给出分类名称和平均分

expect.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, AVG(r.rating) FROM product_reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY AVG(r.rating) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 上个月一共有多少笔订单？

expect.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-09-01' AND created_at < '2026-10-01'

question: 今年 3 月份每个渠道各下了多少单？

gold_sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-01' AND created_at < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY channel

SELECT d.dict_label, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_type = 'channel' AND d.dict_value = o.channel WHERE o.created_at >= '2026-03-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY d.dict_label

question: 最近 7 天有哪些订单？列出订单号和下单时间

expect.gold_sql: SELECT order_no, created_at FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-08 10:00:00'

notes: 按 NOW()-7 天、CURDATE()-7 天或 CURDATE()-6 天计算结果相同（3 笔）
